messages:
lena: quick a11y callout — the keyboard shortcuts overlay (press `?`) doesn't trap focus and screen reader says 'button' then stops. In dark theme the pill is low contrast too. steps to reproduce: open, press tab, focus goes behind overlay. kevin: good catch. can repro on mac VoiceOver + Chrome. also saw no `aria-modal` on the container. :thinking: sam: cc @maria and @a11y-bot — did we recently change the shortcut UI? It used to be a modal. maria: yeah we switched to a non-modal panel for animation smoothness. I didn't think about SR. We can make it a modal for keyboard users and still animate. kevin: proposal: add `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Keyboard shortcuts"`, set focus to first focusable inside, put a visually-hidden announcement like `aria-live="assertive"` text "Keyboard shortcuts opened" when open. lena: also the shortcut hint pill in topbar uses #7a7a7a on dark — contrast is ~3.3:1. needs to be at least 4.5:1 per small text or increase weight/size or add outline. maria: will adjust to #d1d5db or add 1px white outline. prefer color change. jon: small nit: the close `x` is not reachable by keyboard on first tab. Make close first focus target or add `tabindex=0`. kevin: for screen reader discoverability: when user presses `?`, also add a visually-hidden summary list: e.g. `aria-describedby` pointing to hidden `ul` that SR reads with counts, e.g., "7 shortcuts available". lena: sample snippet: ```
Keyboard shortcuts opened — 7 items
    ...
``` maria: I'll PR this afternoon. i'll also run NVDA + VO checks. tagging a11y test owners @a11y-bot :robot_face: a11y-bot: automated note — add test case 'shortcuts-panel-focus-trap' to keyboard regression suite. created ticket INF-4123. sam: thanks! can we add e2e focus test to ensure focus returns to trigger after close? maria: yes, plan to restore focus to the trigger and send small changelog for QA. kevin: sounds good. leaving this as `priority: P2` unless we see customer issues. :thumbsup: lena: thanks all, assigning to @maria. I'll follow up on color tokens and doc the ARIA patterns in design system.
